title: Item Frame 2D
description: Modifies Item Frame rendering for better viewing of blocks with 3D models.
body:
This mod changes the rendering system of item frames. Blocks that normally render their 3D block models in item frames (such as logs or stone) will now render a flattened and enlarged version of the block, helping you quickly recognize the frame's contents.

![Compares the new and old rendering](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/775b212eb6f07efe796f1f7da98500794056e869_0.webp)
